draft_notes.author: host
draft_notes.explanation: Recover 2x2 solid-core components, enumerate their partitions into same-colour non-touching rectangle candidates, require each rectangle to contain at least nine core cells and only single/domino connected background-hole groups. The canonical query has an eight-cell core fragment split by a hole/foreign pixel; it must attach to the neighbouring large core. False mergers across a true background gap are rejected by the hole grammar. Enumerate all valid partitions and require full output agreement. Paint overlap by strict visible own-colour share, and mark holes. All original fixtures unchanged.
draft_notes.limitations: Restricted to the documented two-colour noisy-rectangle family; at most10corecomponents/colour and512combined readings, otherwise rejects. Native unchanged. No hidden drawing-order, source-label, D4 or palette-number tie-break. Pure per-input mechanism does not need demonstrations.
draft_notes.evidence: 1000 unique native pairs/8000D4/palette checks/16fixturevariants. Regression includes native-valid foreign-pixel bridge adversary and canonical fragmented core. The native recognisability check requires connected cores, while explicit canonical query does not; the partition grammar handles both uniformly.
